item.title: Operations Analyst
item.description: Build a career with impact. Working at the World Bank Group (WBG) provides a unique opportunity to help countries solve their greatest development challenges. As one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries, the WBG is a unique partnership of five global institutions dedicated to ending poverty, increasing shared prosperity, and promoting sustainable development. With 189 member countries and more than 120 offices worldwide, the WBG works with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. The Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA) is a member of the World Bank Group with a mission to promote foreign direct investment into developing countries to help end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet. MIGA houses the World Bank Group (WBG) guarantee platform which brings together products and experts from the World Bank, International Finance Corporation (IFC), and MIGA for simplicity, efficiency, and speed. MIGA serves as a one-stop shop for all WBG guarantee business, providing the best guarantee solutions for clients to meet project needs and development priorities. The platform provides three types of coverages: credit guarantees for loans to the public or private sector; trade finance guarantees for trade finance projects involving public entities; and political risk insurance against non-commercial risks for private sector projects or public-private partnerships. For more information, visit www.miga.org . In February 2024, the World Bank Group announced a major upgrade to its guarantees business that will deliver improved guarantee access through a unified team at MIGA as well as innovative new guarantee solutions. These new reforms will help position MIGA to achieve the goal of tripling annual guarantee issuance to $20 billion by 2030. MIGA’s Operations Department (MIGOP) leads MIGA’s guarantee business development and origination activities, structures transactions, and leads projects through the underwriting and approval process, and manages our guarantees portfolio. Within MIGOP, the Global Transaction Team (GTT) is a dedicated team of Operations Analysts, Underwriters, and Senior Underwriters with a focus on underwriting MIGA’s guarantee transactions. MIGOP is seeking a highly experienced, motivated, and proactive Operations Analyst with strong project finance, public sector finance, and/or political risk insurance underwriting skills, as well as client and new business origination skills, preferably gained in the energy and general infrastructure sectors. While reporting to the Manager for GTT, the Operations Analyst will work closely with Transaction Team Leads (Underwriters and Senior Underwriters) on underwriting guarantee transactions. Depending on experience, the activities may also include supporting business origination and transaction structuring activities. Through this role, the Operations Analyst will develop a broad knowledge of MIGA’s guarantee activities by working on transactions across the Platform’s full product line (including, PRI including Capital Optimization, Non-Honoring for both the real and financial sectors, and trade finance guarantees) and across regions and sectors (energy and extractives industries, infrastructure, financial institutions, capital markets, manufacturing, agriculture, services, etc.). Note that this is initially a Washington, DC-based position, however given the regionalization agenda, there is a strong possibility of this position being selected for decentralization. If shortlisted, this will be discussed with you at interview. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES • Work on multi-disciplinary transaction teams within MIGA (legal, environment and social, climate finance, reinsurance, gender, integrity, risk, development impact, etc.) throughout the transaction lifecycle including underwriting, approvals and guarantee negotiation • Conduct independent research and analysis on various topics including the transaction investor and sector and support analysis on the technical and commercial viability of the investment project • Prepare and use complex financial models to, amongst others, analyze the financial viability of the investment project or support credit analysis for credit enhancement transactions • Engage with MIGA’s clients, conduct in-country and virtual due diligence meetings with host country government officials, and collaborate with partners (e.g. World Bank, IFC, and other development finance partners) • Prepare guarantee pricing estimates for clients • Contribute to preparation of high-quality guarantee proposal documents and participate in presentations to MIGA’s Senior Management • In close coordination with MIGA Senior/Sector Underwriters, Sector Managers, and Regional Heads, support MIGA’s new business origination and client management efforts and, as required, conduct industry and client research • As required, prepare talking points and presentations for new business origination-focused activities with project sponsors, government officials, state-owned enterprises, financial institutions, specialist industry groups, and forums • As required, collaborate with the portfolio team to provide analytical support in respect of portfolio management activities • As required, conduct integrity searches on potential clients, project participants and stakeholders.

item.title: Head of Division – Monitoring and Peer Review
item.description: {"id":"744000140715019","name":"Head of Division – Monitoring and Peer Review ","uuid":"529618dd-df8d-4d7c-8b21-892e08b3e2fd","jobId":"84d48e5d-cd17-4a1a-a192-262a8b16eb82","jobAdId":"a25145f6-c6c1-4aed-ab34-94b5aed2b425","defaultJobAd":true,"refNumber":"REF3302V","company":{"name":"OECD","identifier":"OECD"},"location":{"city":"Paris","region":"Île-de-France Region","country":"fr","remote":false,"hybrid":false,"fullLocation":"Paris, Île-de-France Region, France"},"customField":[{"fieldId":"648821a3b6b69322b51f3093","fieldLabel":"Directorate","valueId":"10000271","valueLabel":"CTP"},{"fieldId":"COUNTRY","fieldLabel":"Country/Region","valueId":"fr","valueLabel":"France"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4cccb","fieldLabel":"Department","valueId":"6104231","valueLabel":"Executive Leadership"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4ccca","fieldLabel":"Brands","valueId":"default","valueLabel":"OECD"},{"fieldId":"64882104a519d256d6751438","fieldLabel":"Grade","valueId":"EL1","valueLabel":"EL1"}],"releasedDate":"2026-07-30T15:04:01.937Z","creator":{"name":"","avatarUrl":""},"postingUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000140715019-head-of-division-monitoring-and-peer-review-","applyUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000140715019-head-of-division-monitoring-and-peer-review-?oga=true","referralUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/external-referrals/company/OECD/publication/529618dd-df8d-4d7c-8b21-892e08b3e2fd?dcr_ci=OECD","jobAd":{"sections":{"companyDescription":{"title":"Company Description","text":" THE OECD – Who we are, what we do The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development ( OECD ) is an international organisation comprised of 38 member countries, that works to build better policies for better lives. Our mission is to promote policies that will improve the economic and social well-being of people around the world. Together with governments, policy makers and citizens, we work on establishing evidence-based international standards, and finding solutions to a range of social, economic and environmental challenges. From improving economic performance and creating jobs to fostering strong education and fighting international tax evasion, we provide a unique forum and knowledge hub for data and analysis, exchange of experiences, best-practice sharing, and advice on public policies and international standard-setting. THE GLOBAL FORUM The Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes (the Global Forum), whose Secretariat is hosted by the OECD’s Centre for Tax Policy and Administration (CTPA), plays a central role in promoting and monitoring the implementation of international standards on transparency and exchange of information (EOI). With over 170 members ( www.oecd.org/tax/transparency ) participating on an equal footing, the Global Forum supports the fight against tax evasion and avoidance by conducting peer reviews and monitoring activities and delivering capacity building to help them implement and benefit from these standards. Its work covers tax transparency standards, such as the Transparency and Exchange of Information on Request (EOIR), the Common Reporting Standard (CRS) for automatic exchange of financial accounts information, the Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), and the associated confidentiality and data safeguards (CDS) requirements. THE POSITION The Global Forum is looking for a dynamic Head of Division to provide leadership and strategic direction. As a key member of its Senior Management team, s/he will lead the Monitoring and Peer Review Division, overseeing the monitoring and peer review the implementation of the transparency and exchange of information standards, promoting their effective implementation and supporting reforms to ensure they remain effective tools against tax avoidance and evasion. The Division also supports the Global Forum’s work to establish partnerships with stakeholders in the tax and development community. The successful candidate will work closely with, and report to, the Head of the Global Forum Secretariat. The scope and the complexity of the Global Forum’s work require an experienced senior executive with expertise in tax policy and administration, international development and political processes. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with political acumen, experienced in delivering a complex Programme of Work and Budget, leading international teams and maintaining a professional network. "},"jobDescription":{"title":"Job Description","text":" Main Responsibilities Leadership Support the implementation of the Global Forum’s Programme of Work and Budget (PWB) and the advancement of its strategic outcomes, with a focus on monitoring and peer review of the standards in transparency and exchange of information for tax purposes. Support the Office of the Secretary-General, the OECD Sherpa, and their respective teams on targeted policy advice and on the OECD’s contributions in the area of tax and development, including to the G20 and G7. Lead on the design and management of the Global Forum’s monitoring and peer review programmes, ensuring the effectiveness of the standards and promoting the necessary reforms to meet the needs of all member jurisdictions. Lead on ensuring the quality and consistency of the implementation of the Global Forum’s monitoring and peer review processes, managing key stakeholders and ensuring consistency and coherence across outputs. Ensure the Global Forum’s work reflects the needs of all its member jurisdictions, and promotes effective standards, including by leading the Global Forum’s engagement across the OECD and with member jurisdictions to deliver the Common Transmission System. Foster cross-organisational collaboration, particularly with the OECD Development Cluster, on tax and development issues. Contribute to strengthening the OECD and the Global Forum’s standing as authoritative reference centres for analysis and guidance on tax policy and administration among member jurisdictions and relevant stakeholders. Support the effective global reach of the OECD and the Global Forum’s work on tax transparency and exchange of information, including through rigorous public reporting and sustained engagement with key partners, in alignment with the OECD’s global relations strategy. Representation and Liaison Represent the Global Forum Secretariat and the OECD in internal and external meetings. Establish and maintain strong networks with international organisations, national authorities, academia, and research institutions. Actively contribute to the effective dissemination of the Global Forum’s work through the media, professional networks, academia and other communities. Prepare timely and accurate responses to briefing requests from the Secretary-General’s Office and other parts of the Organisation. Develop strategic relationships with key international and regional organisations active in tax transparency. Management and Co-ordination Ensure effective coordination and collaboration across the Organisation, including with the Office of the Secretary-General and policy directorates, to support corporate initiatives and horizontal projects. Lead and manage Division staff by setting clear objectives, providing direction and feedback, supporting professional development, and promoting effective project management and internal communication. Build and lead a cohesive, diverse, and inclusive team, fostering excellence and a collaborative work environment. Uphold and promote the OECD’s highest professional standards and ethical principles, ensuring a supportive and respectful workplace. Oversee the organisation and smooth delivery of all meetings under the Division’s responsibility. Effectively manage human and financial resources to deliver the programme of work and budget and fulfil the Division’s commitments. "},"qualifications":{"title":"Qualifications","text":" Ideal Candidate Profile Academic and Professional Background An advanced university degree in economics, legal and/or a professional qualification in tax or a related subject. At least 10 years’ experience at a senior level in a national government, the private sector or an international organisation working on tax and/or exchange of information for tax purposes, including managerial duties in addition to substantive areas responsibility. Excellent knowledge of current tax challenges facing governments, including in the developing world, and an ability to effectively communicate and formulate advice and recommendations in a clear, practical and accessible manner. Proven record of developing relations at a senior level and within a political decision-making environment. Well-established contacts with stakeholders in the relevant international communities. Extensive experience in developing innovative products/outputs and conducting rigorous analysis. A broad knowledge of the Global Forum's substantive work, and a strategic sense of its role in the overall framework of international co-operation and domestic policy formulation. "},"additionalInformation":{"title":"Additional Information","text":" Communication and Languages Fluency in one of the two OECD official languages (English and French) and a knowledge of, or a willingness to learn, the other. Knowledge of other languages would be an asset. Core Competencies Staff in Executive Leadership are expected to demonstrate behaviours aligned to six core competencies which will be assessed as part of this hiring processes at level 3: Vision and Strategy; Enable People; Ethics and Integrity; Collaboration and Horizontality; Achieve Results; Innovate and Embrace Change. To learn more about the definitions for each competency, please refer to the OECD Core Competency Framework . Closing Date Contract Duration Please note that our Rules and Regulations stipulate that the mandatory retirement age is 67. Together with governments, policy makers and citizens, we work on establishing evidence-based international standards, and finding solutions to a range of social, economic and environmental challenges. From improving economic performance and creating jobs to fostering strong education and fighting international tax evasion, we provide a unique forum and knowledge hub for data and analysis, exchange of experiences, best-practice sharing, and advice on public policies and international standard-setting. The Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Directorate, in line with the strategic objectives of the Secretary-General, helps OECD member countries and other key economies build an environment conducive to translating science, technology and knowledge into innovation in order to create economic and social value added. The Digital Connectivity, Economics and Society Division (DCES) of the STI is responsible for developing evidence, analysis and policy recommendations on critical topics for digital policymaking, including online safety, digital security, digital well-being, connectivity and infrastructure, critical technologies (e.g. semiconductors) and measuring digital transformation. STI/DCES is looking for an engaged and innovative Policy Researcher with a background in economics to support the Working Party on Digital Economics, Measurement and Analysis (WPDEMA) of the Digital Policy Committee (DPC) and DCES's work on measuring digital transformation. The successful candidate will have good knowledge of core economic concepts and advanced skills using statistical or econometric techniques, good programming skills, and proven ability to communicate complex results. S/he will be required to work independently but also collaborating effectively with other team members. The selected person will work under the supervision of a senior team member and the Head of the DCES Division in STI. "},"jobDescription":{"title":"Job Description","text":" Main Responsibilities Economic research and data science work Contribute to economic research projects under the auspices of the WPDEMA on the diffusion of digital technologies and their impacts on key economic outcomes (e.g. competition, labour markets, productivity). Contribute to the external visibility of the DCES Division, for example by participating and presenting work at workshops, conferences, etc. "},"qualifications":{"title":"Qualifications","text":" Ideal Candidate Profile Academic Background: An advanced university degree in economics, statistics, mathematics or a closely related field. Tools: Familiarity with database software; a working knowledge of the main ICT databases in use at the OECD and/or in other international or national agencies would be an advantage. item.description: {"id":"744000140968972","name":"Chercheur/chercheuse en politiques publiques (Économie) – Économie numérique ","uuid":"897cf3e3-7020-4086-9b0c-4d20e7d2be8a","jobId":"79d570f7-9f45-415e-819a-e605f5fba2c0","jobAdId":"2c27795e-834c-41c5-bd8b-fb85a0a26aff","defaultJobAd":false,"refNumber":"REF3305C","company":{"name":"OECD","identifier":"OECD"},"location":{"city":"Paris","region":"Île-de-France Region","country":"fr","remote":false,"hybrid":false,"fullLocation":"Paris, Île-de-France Region, France"},"customField":[{"fieldId":"648821a3b6b69322b51f3093","fieldLabel":"Directorate","valueId":"10001210","valueLabel":"STI"},{"fieldId":"COUNTRY","fieldLabel":"Country/Region","valueId":"fr","valueLabel":"France"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4cccb","fieldLabel":"Department","valueId":"6106611","valueLabel":"Policy Analysis and Legal"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4ccca","fieldLabel":"Brands","valueId":"default","valueLabel":"OECD"},{"fieldId":"64882104a519d256d6751438","fieldLabel":"Grade","valueId":"PAL3","valueLabel":"PAL3"}],"releasedDate":"2026-07-31T17:37:18.598Z","creator":{"name":"","avatarUrl":""},"postingUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000140968972-chercheur-chercheuse-en-politiques-publiques-economie-economie-numerique-","applyUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000140968972-chercheur-chercheuse-en-politiques-publiques-economie-economie-numerique-?oga=true","referralUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/external-referrals/company/OECD/publication/897cf3e3-7020-4086-9b0c-4d20e7d2be8a?dcr_ci=OECD","jobAd":{"sections":{"companyDescription":{"title":"Description de l'entreprise","text":" L’Organisation de coopération et de développement économiques ( OCDE ) est une organisation internationale regroupant 38 pays Membres, qui œuvre pour la mise en place de politiques meilleures pour une vie meilleure. Notre mission consiste à promouvoir des politiques de nature à améliorer le bien-être économique et social des populations du monde entier. Aux côtés des gouvernants, des responsables publics et des citoyens, nous nous employons à établir des normes internationales fondées sur des éléments probants et à trouver des solutions à un large éventail de défis sociaux, économiques et environnementaux. Qu’il s’agisse d’améliorer les performances économiques, de créer des emplois, de renforcer les systèmes éducatifs ou encore de lutter contre la fraude fiscale internationale, nous proposons un forum et une plateforme de connaissances sans équivalent, qui permettent aux parties intéressées de trouver des données et des analyses, de partager des expériences, de mutualiser des bonnes pratiques, et d’obtenir des conseils sur les politiques publiques et l’établissement de normes internationales. Conformément aux objectifs stratégiques du Secrétaire général, la Direction de la science, de la technologie et de l’innovation (STI) aide les pays Membres de l’OCDE et d’autres grandes économies à bâtir un environnement propice aux innovations issues de la science, de la technologie et des connaissances, en vue de créer une valeur ajoutée économique et sociale. La Division de la connectivité, de l’économie et de la société numériques (DCES), rattachée à la Direction STI, est chargée de produire des données factuelles, des analyses et des recommandations stratégiques sur des sujets fondamentaux essentiels pour la formulation de politiques du numérique, de la sûreté en ligne à la sécurité numérique, en passant par le bien-être numérique, la connectivité et les infrastructures, les technologies critiques (à l’instar des semi-conducteurs), ou encore la mesure de la transformation numérique. STI/DCES est à la recherche d’un chercheur/d’une chercheuse en politiques publiques motivé·e et inventif·ve ayant une expérience dans le domaine de l’économie pour apporter un soutien au Groupe de travail sur l’économie, la mesure et l’analyse du numérique (GTEMAN) au sein du Comité de la politique du numérique (CPN) et contribuer aux travaux de la DCES sur la mesure de la transformation numérique. La personne retenue aura une bonne connaissance des concepts économiques fondamentaux, sera experte dans l’utilisation des techniques statistiques ou économétriques et aura une bonne connaissance de la programmation. De plus, elle possèdera une aptitude avérée à communiquer des résultats complexes. Elle devra faire preuve d’autonomie, mais aussi collaborer avec d’autres membres de l’équipe. Elle travaillera sous la direction d’un membre de haut rang de l’équipe et de la Cheffe de la DCES au sein de STI. "},"jobDescription":{"title":"Description du poste","text":" Responsabilités principales Recherche économique et travaux relatifs à la science des données Contribuer aux projets de recherche économique menés sous l’égide du GTEMAN qui portent sur la diffusion des technologies numériques et leurs répercussions sur les résultats économiques clés (par exemple en ce qui concerne la concurrence, les marchés du travail et la productivité). Employer des approches faisant appel à l’économétrie et l’apprentissage automatique, mais aussi potentiellement à l’analyse géospatiale et/ou au traitement automatique du langage naturel. Prêter son concours à la rédaction de documents, notamment de documents de travail et de présentations, contenant des analyses quantitatives et des modélisations. Soutenir les travaux du GTEMAN visant à élaborer des normes et définitions statistiques pour la transformation numérique, et contribuer à la mise en œuvre de la Feuille de route sur la mesure de la transformation numérique. Communication et liaison Nouer de bonnes relations de travail avec les collègues au sein de STI et dans l’ensemble de l’OCDE, ainsi qu’avec les économistes et statisticiens des administrations nationales et d’autres organisations internationales. Participer aux réunions et ateliers du GTEMAN ainsi qu’à des réunions et ateliers connexes. Aider à l’élaboration de documents et d’outils méthodologiques. Contribuer à la visibilité externe de la DCES, notamment en prenant part à des ateliers, des conférences, etc., et en y présentant des travaux. "},"qualifications":{"title":"Qualifications","text":" Profil idéal Formation Diplôme universitaire de niveau supérieur en économie, statistique, ou mathématiques, ou dans une discipline connexe. Expérience professionnelle Au moins deux ans d’expérience pertinente en analyse économique et un vif intérêt pour la production et/ou l’utilisation de méthodologies quantitatives avancées. La connaissance de la manière de concevoir une enquête statistique, des méthodes expérimentales de collecte de données et du traitement des sources de données non conventionnelles, constituerait un avantage. Bonne aptitude à communiquer des résultats complexes. Expérience de la gestion de projets et de la participation à des projets pluridisciplinaires. Outils Connaissance de logiciels de base de données ; une connaissance pratique des principales bases de données sur les TIC en usage à l’OCDE et/ou dans d’autres organismes internationaux ou nationaux constituerait un avantage. Connaissance d’au moins un logiciel utilisé aux fins de l’analyse quantitative (Stata, R, GAMS ou SAS, par exemple). La connaissance de Python constituerait un avantage. Bonne connaissance de Git aux fins de la gestion des versions, ou volonté d’apprendre à l’utiliser. Langues Parfaite maîtrise d’une des deux langues officielles de l’OCDE (le français et l’anglais) et connaissance de l’autre langue, que la personne retenue s’engage à porter à un bon niveau. Compétences clés Les membres du personnel de l’OCDE sont censés faire preuve d’un comportement conforme aux six compétences clés qui seront évaluées dans le cadre de la procédure de recrutement organisée au titre de la présente offre d’emploi : Vision et stratégie (niveau 1) ; Renforcement des capacités des personnes (niveau 1) ; Éthique et intégrité (niveau 1) ; Collaboration et horizontalité (niveau 2) ; Obtention de résultats (niveau 1) ; Innovation et acceptation du changement (niveau 2). Pour en savoir plus sur les définitions des niveaux de maîtrise 1 à 3 associés à chaque compétence, veuillez vous référer au Cadre de compétences clés de l’OCDE . "},"additionalInformation":{"title":"Informations supplémentaires","text":" Durée du contrat Durée déterminée de 13 mois, avec possibilité de renouvellement jusqu’à un maximum de 36 mois. Date de clôture Les fonctions décrites ci-dessus devront être pourvues dès que possible, et les candidatures devront nous parvenir au plus tard à 23h59 le 13 septembre 2026 (heure de Paris). Veuillez noter que, conformément aux Statut et Règlement applicables aux agents de l’Organisation, l’âge de départ obligatoire à la retraite est fixé à 67 ans. Ce qu’offre l’OCDE Le salaire mensuel minimum s’élève à 5.279 EUR, plus allocations/indemnités en fonction d’éligibilité, la rémunération globale étant exonérée d’impôt sur le revenu en France. Cliquez ici pour consulter les Statut, règlement et instructions applicables aux agents de l’OCDE. Veuillez noter que toute personne nommée agent·e à compter du 1er juillet 2025 sera engagée conformément aux nouvelles modalités contractuelles de l’OCDE . Cliquez ici pour en savoir plus sur ce que propose l’OCDE et sur son environnement de travail exceptionnel. Cliquez ici pour feuilleter en ligne notre Guide de gestion du personnel afin d’en savoir plus sur tous les aspects touchant aux ressources humaines de l’Organisation, à notre environnement de travail et aux nombreuses autres mesures destinées à faciliter le quotidien des agents. Veuillez noter que la personne retenue pourra être engagée à un grade inférieur, en fonction de ses qualifications et de son expérience professionnelle. La présente offre d’emploi pourrait servir à la constitution d’un vivier de candidat·es jugé·es aptes à exercer des fonctions comparables dans le cadre d’un engagement de durée indéterminée ou déterminée. item.description: {"id":"744000141302924","name":"Analyste de la sécurité et des réseaux électriques","uuid":"6ce1fc74-96e7-44d6-ac3d-2569690427f7","jobId":"95140137-15e3-49d4-a9e8-415e9e9c7dcf","jobAdId":"d8cc7ab4-681b-4b13-a3d1-829f05d0f2b9","defaultJobAd":false,"refNumber":"REF3341X","company":{"name":"OECD","identifier":"OECD"},"location":{"city":"Paris","region":"Île-de-France Region","country":"fr","remote":false,"hybrid":false,"fullLocation":"Paris, Île-de-France Region, France"},"customField":[{"fieldId":"648821a3b6b69322b51f3093","fieldLabel":"Directorate","valueId":"10000727","valueLabel":"IEA"},{"fieldId":"COUNTRY","fieldLabel":"Country/Region","valueId":"fr","valueLabel":"France"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4cccb","fieldLabel":"Department","valueId":"6106611","valueLabel":"Policy Analysis and Legal"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4ccca","fieldLabel":"Brands","valueId":"5a9445ef-058b-4346-8dca-ef49c8638ded","valueLabel":"IEA"},{"fieldId":"64882104a519d256d6751438","fieldLabel":"Grade","valueId":"PAL6","valueLabel":"PAL6"}],"releasedDate":"2026-08-03T15:59:10.562Z","creator":{"name":"","avatarUrl":""},"postingUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000141302924-analyste-de-la-securite-et-des-reseaux-electriques","applyUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000141302924-analyste-de-la-securite-et-des-reseaux-electriques?oga=true","referralUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/external-referrals/company/OECD/publication/6ce1fc74-96e7-44d6-ac3d-2569690427f7?dcr_ci=OECD","jobAd":{"sections":{"companyDescription":{"title":"Description de l'entreprise","text":" L’Organisation de coopération et de développement économiques ( OCDE ) est une organisation internationale regroupant 38 pays Membres, qui œuvre pour la mise en place de politiques meilleures pour une vie meilleure. Notre mission consiste à promouvoir des politiques de nature à améliorer le bien-être économique et social des populations du monde entier. Aux côtés des gouvernants, des responsables publics et des citoyens, nous nous employons à établir des normes internationales fondées sur des éléments probants et à trouver des solutions à un large éventail de défis sociaux, économiques et environnementaux. Qu’il s’agisse d’améliorer les performances économiques, de créer des emplois, de renforcer les systèmes éducatifs ou encore de lutter contre la fraude fiscale internationale, nous proposons un forum et une plateforme de connaissances sans équivalent, qui permettent aux parties intéressées de trouver des données et des analyses, de partager des expériences, de mutualiser des bonnes pratiques, et d’obtenir des conseils sur les politiques publiques et l’établissement de normes internationales. L’ Agence internationale de l’énergie (AIE) est une organisation intergouvernementale qui œuvre en faveur de la sécurité des approvisionnements énergétiques, de la croissance économique et de la durabilité environnementale en promouvant la coopération dans le domaine des politiques énergétiques. L’AIE fonctionne en tant qu’organe autonome au sein de l’Organisation de coopération et de développement économiques. L’AIE recherche des analystes de la sécurité et des réseaux électriques pour contribuer à ses travaux d’analyse des réseaux et de l’électrification menés au sein de sa Division des systèmes et marchés de l’électricité (ESM). Les personnes retenues prendront part aux travaux de la Division sur la sécurité de l’approvisionnement en électricité et, en particulier, la modernisation des réseaux de transport et de distribution. Il s’agira d’analyser et de modéliser les systèmes électriques sous l’angle physique et techno-économique, et d’élaborer des projets axés sur les réseaux. "},"jobDescription":{"title":"Description du poste","text":" Responsabilités principales Modélisation, analyse et rédaction Piloter les travaux techniques, d’analyse et de modélisation de la Division consacrés aux systèmes électriques, à la modernisation des réseaux (transport et distribution) et à la sécurité de l’approvisionnement en électricité. Conduire des travaux d’analyse portant sur les moyens d’intégrer au système les nouvelles sources de production d’électricité et les nouvelles formes de demande, en mettant l’accent sur la sécurité d’exploitation, la fiabilité et la résilience. Analyser les évolutions de la gestion de la congestion, des processus de raccordement au réseau et de la planification stratégique des réseaux sur les principaux marchés de l’électricité. Suivre les innovations et les pratiques opérationnelles visant à permettre une utilisation plus efficiente des réseaux, notamment les technologies d’amélioration des réseaux, les solutions numériques et les cadres de réglementation. Contribuer à l’exécution du programme de l’AIE relatif à la sécurité de l’approvisionnement en électricité, et prendre part à la rédaction de contenus relatifs au réseau pour le rapport de l’AIE sur l’électricité et d’autres publications pertinentes de la Division des systèmes et marchés de l’électricité. Collaboration et relations avec l’extérieur Échanger avec les principales parties prenantes du secteur ; prêter son concours, en tant que de besoin, aux préparatifs des réunions des comités permanents, des groupes de travail et, si nécessaire, d’autres groupes de l’AIE ; participer aux réunions pertinentes d’autres organisations internationales ; concourir à l’établissement des rapports, analyses et éléments d’information destinés à ces réunions. "},"qualifications":{"title":"Qualifications","text":" Profil idéal Formation Diplôme universitaire de niveau supérieur ou doctorat en génie électrique, génie énergétique, génie des systèmes énergétiques, économie de l’énergie, physique ou dans une discipline connexe. Expérience professionnelle Au moins cinq à sept ans d’expérience directement acquise sur les systèmes électriques dans une entreprise du secteur de l’électricité, une société de conseil économique, une entreprise axée sur les technologies de réseau ou une autorité de réglementation de l’électricité, en travaillant sur les réseaux de transport ou de distribution, l’exploitation des systèmes, la gestion de l’énergie ou un domaine connexe. Solide connaissance technique des systèmes électriques et compréhension approfondie des concepts liés à la sécurité de l’approvisionnement en électricité, des fondamentaux du marché de l’électricité et de l’interaction entre l’exploitation du système et les incitations du marché. Solide connaissance des réseaux de distribution de moyenne et de basse tension, avec une bonne compréhension des cadres régissant les processus de raccordement et l’intégration des ressources énergétiques décentralisées. Une expérience de la planification du réseau et des pratiques opérationnelles visant à améliorer l’efficience et l’utilisation des infrastructures existantes est souhaitable. Une expérience de la modélisation des systèmes électriques, notamment la modélisation des réseaux en régime stationnaire, en régime dynamique ou en stabilité transitoire, ou de l’étude de la planification ou de l’extension du réseau constituerait un avantage. Capacités d’analyse avérées et excellente compétence rédactionnelle, confirmées par les produits de travaux antérieurs (rapports analytiques, analyses quantitatives, modèles opératoires et/ou textes publiés). Outils Excellente maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office, en particulier d’Excel. Une expérience de SQL ou Power Query constituerait un atout. Solide connaissance de langages de programmation pertinents (Python par exemple). Une expérience de logiciels de modélisation de réseau pertinents (PowerFactory, PSS, PSCAD, par exemple) constituerait un avantage. Langues Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral, avec des compétences rédactionnelles et éditoriales. La connaissance d’une ou de plusieurs autres langues constituerait un atout. "},"additionalInformation":{"title":"Informations supplémentaires","text":" Compétences clés Les membres du personnel de l’OCDE sont censés faire preuve d’un comportement conforme aux six compétences clés qui seront évaluées dans le cadre de la procédure de recrutement organisée au titre de la présente offre d’emploi : Vision et stratégie (niveau 2) ; Renforcement des capacités des personnes (niveau 1) ; Éthique et intégrité (niveau 2) ; Collaboration et horizontalité (niveau 2) ; Obtention de résultats (niveau 2) ; Innovation et acceptation du changement (niveau 2). item.title: Electricity Grids and Security Analyst
item.description: {"id":"744000141302735","name":"Electricity Grids and Security Analyst","uuid":"ead9fc3e-8e6a-4885-a190-bce906819480","jobId":"95140137-15e3-49d4-a9e8-415e9e9c7dcf","jobAdId":"fdf70a81-bda1-4dc9-a906-c1d720873d47","defaultJobAd":true,"refNumber":"REF3341X","company":{"name":"OECD","identifier":"OECD"},"location":{"city":"Paris","region":"Île-de-France Region","country":"fr","remote":false,"hybrid":false,"fullLocation":"Paris, Île-de-France Region, France"},"customField":[{"fieldId":"648821a3b6b69322b51f3093","fieldLabel":"Directorate","valueId":"10000727","valueLabel":"IEA"},{"fieldId":"COUNTRY","fieldLabel":"Country/Region","valueId":"fr","valueLabel":"France"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4cccb","fieldLabel":"Department","valueId":"6106611","valueLabel":"Policy Analysis and Legal"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4ccca","fieldLabel":"Brands","valueId":"5a9445ef-058b-4346-8dca-ef49c8638ded","valueLabel":"IEA"},{"fieldId":"64882104a519d256d6751438","fieldLabel":"Grade","valueId":"PAL6","valueLabel":"PAL6"}],"releasedDate":"2026-08-03T16:01:27.490Z","creator":{"name":"","avatarUrl":""},"postingUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000141302735-electricity-grids-and-security-analyst","applyUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000141302735-electricity-grids-and-security-analyst?oga=true","referralUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/external-referrals/company/OECD/publication/ead9fc3e-8e6a-4885-a190-bce906819480?dcr_ci=OECD","jobAd":{"sections":{"companyDescription":{"title":"Company Description","text":" The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development ( OECD ) is an international organisation comprised of 38 member countries, that works to build better policies for better lives. Our mission is to promote policies that will improve the economic and social well-being of people around the world. Together with governments, policy makers and citizens, we work on establishing evidence-based international standards, and finding solutions to a range of social, economic and environmental challenges. From improving economic performance and creating jobs to fostering strong education and fighting international tax evasion, we provide a unique forum and knowledge hub for data and analysis, exchange of experiences, best-practice sharing, and advice on public policies and international standard-setting. The International Energy Agency (IEA) is an intergovernmental organisation committed to advancing security of energy supply, economic growth and environmental sustainability through energy policy co-operation. The IEA operates as an autonomous body within the framework of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD). The IEA seeks to recruit Electricity Grids and Security Analysts to contribute to its analytical work on grids and electrification in the Electricity Systems and Markets Division (ESM). The Electricity Gris and Security Analysts will support the Division’s work on electricity security, with a particular focus on transmission and distribution system modernisation. This includes to analyse and model power systems from physical and technoeconomic perspectives, and to draft grid-focused projects. "},"jobDescription":{"title":"Job Description","text":" Main Responsibilities Modelling, analysis and drafting Lead the Division’s technical, analytical and modelling work on power systems, grid modernisation (transmission and distribution), and electricity security. Lead analytical work on the system integration of emerging sources of electricity demand and generation, with a focus on operational security, reliability and resilience. Analyse developments in congestion management, grid connection processes, and strategic grid planning across key power markets. Monitor innovations and operational practices aimed at enabling more efficient use of grids, including Grid Ehancing Technologies (GETs), digital solutions, and regulatory frameworks. Contribute to the delivery of the IEA’s Electricity Security programme and to drafting grid-related content for the IEA’s Electricity report and other relevant ESM publications. Collaboration and outreach Engage with key industry stakeholders; support preparations as needed for meetings of IEA standing committees, working parties and other groups as required; participate in relevant meetings of other international organisations; provide support for the development of reports, analyses and information items for these meetings. "},"qualifications":{"title":"Qualifications","text":" Ideal Candidate Profile Academic Background Advanced university degree or PhD in Electrical / Power / Energy Systems Engineering, Energy Economics, Physics or a related discipline. Professional Background At least five years to seven years of direct power systems work experience in the electricity industry, economic consulting, grid technology companies, or at an electric regulatory agency working on transmission or distribution networks, system operation, energy management and related fields. Strong technical background in power systems and in-depth understanding of electricity security concepts, power market fundamentals, and the interaction between system operations and market incentives. Solid knowledge of medium- and low-voltage distribution grids, with an understanding of the frameworks governing connection processes and the integration of distributed energy resources. Experience with network planning and operational practices aimed at enhancing the efficiency and utilisation of existing infrastructure is desirable. Experience with power system modelling, such as steady‑state network modelling, dynamic and transient stability modelling, or grid planning and expansion studies, would be an advantage. Proven analytical abilities and excellent writing skills as demonstrated in past work products (analytical reports, quantitative analysis, operative models, and/or published papers). Tools Excellent command of Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel. Experience with SQL or Power Query is an asset. Solid knowledge of relevant coding languages (e.g. Python). Experience with relevant grid modelling software (e.g. PowerFactory, PSS, PSCAD) would be an advantage. Languages Excellent written and oral command of English, including drafting and proofreading. item.description: {"id":"744000141745339","name":"Analyste junior du secteur de l’électricité","uuid":"5e6c8476-3d80-44c6-93f4-4bb306ae803a","jobId":"f204b628-f7b3-4abf-af0e-b0b5f4e2ad25","jobAdId":"556ed716-3c68-4089-9373-8da09b8d4930","defaultJobAd":false,"refNumber":"REF3349P","company":{"name":"OECD","identifier":"OECD"},"location":{"city":"Paris","region":"Île-de-France Region","country":"fr","remote":false,"hybrid":false,"fullLocation":"Paris, Île-de-France Region, France"},"customField":[{"fieldId":"648821a3b6b69322b51f3093","fieldLabel":"Directorate","valueId":"10000727","valueLabel":"IEA"},{"fieldId":"COUNTRY","fieldLabel":"Country/Region","valueId":"fr","valueLabel":"France"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4cccb","fieldLabel":"Department","valueId":"6106611","valueLabel":"Policy Analysis and Legal"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4ccca","fieldLabel":"Brands","valueId":"5a9445ef-058b-4346-8dca-ef49c8638ded","valueLabel":"IEA"},{"fieldId":"64882104a519d256d6751438","fieldLabel":"Grade","valueId":"PAL4","valueLabel":"PAL4"}],"releasedDate":"2026-08-05T15:03:43.330Z","creator":{"name":"","avatarUrl":""},"postingUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000141745339-analyste-junior-du-secteur-de-l-electricite","applyUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000141745339-analyste-junior-du-secteur-de-l-electricite?oga=true","referralUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/external-referrals/company/OECD/publication/5e6c8476-3d80-44c6-93f4-4bb306ae803a?dcr_ci=OECD","jobAd":{"sections":{"companyDescription":{"title":"Description de l'entreprise","text":" L’Organisation de coopération et de développement économiques ( OCDE ) est une organisation internationale regroupant 38 pays Membres, qui œuvre pour la mise en place de politiques meilleures pour une vie meilleure. Notre mission consiste à promouvoir des politiques de nature à améliorer le bien-être économique et social des populations du monde entier. Aux côtés des gouvernants, des responsables publics et des citoyens, nous nous employons à établir des normes internationales fondées sur des éléments probants et à trouver des solutions à un large éventail de défis sociaux, économiques et environnementaux. Qu’il s’agisse d’améliorer les performances économiques, de créer des emplois, de renforcer les systèmes éducatifs ou encore de lutter contre la fraude fiscale internationale, nous proposons un forum et une plateforme de connaissances sans équivalent, qui permettent aux parties intéressées de trouver des données et des analyses, de partager des expériences, de mutualiser des bonnes pratiques, et d’obtenir des conseils sur les politiques publiques et l’établissement de normes internationales. L’ Agence internationale de l’énergie (AIE) est une organisation intergouvernementale qui œuvre en faveur de la sécurité des approvisionnements énergétiques, de la croissance économique et de la durabilité environnementale en promouvant la coopération dans le domaine des politiques énergétiques. L’AIE fonctionne en tant qu’organe autonome au sein de l’Organisation de coopération et de développement économiques. L’AIE recherche des analystes juniors du secteur de l’électricité pour contribuer à ses travaux d’analyse sur les systèmes et les marchés de l’électricité au sein de sa Division des systèmes et marchés de l’électricité (ESM). Les personnes retenues prendront part aux travaux de la Division sur les systèmes et marchés de l’électricité et, en particulier, les réseaux. Il s’agira de produire des analyses quantitatives et qualitatives, de réaliser des modélisations et de rédiger des textes, notamment pour le rapport phare annuel de l’AIE consacré à l’électricité. "},"jobDescription":{"title":"Description du poste","text":" Responsabilités principales Modélisation, analyse et rédaction Suivre et analyser les avancées techniques et les évolutions de la réglementation et de l’action publique en lien avec les systèmes et les marchés de l’électricité, aux niveaux mondial, régional et national. Prêter son concours aux travaux d’analyse de la Division sur les réseaux, la flexibilité du système électrique et la réglementation. Contribuer à la réalisation de modélisations en vue d’établir des prévisions à moyen terme relatives à l’électricité : à cet effet, mettre au point, appliquer et actualiser des modèles du secteur de l’électricité. Mettre à jour et améliorer les bases de données pertinentes sur les avancées techniques, la réglementation et l’action publique, qui concernent l’offre et la demande d’électricité ainsi que les réseaux (transport et distribution). Aider à préparer, de bout en bout, le rapport de l’AIE sur l’électricité. Participer à la rédaction de rapports et de documents de travail, et à la préparation d’exposés et de notes de synthèse à l’intention de l’équipe de direction. Collaboration et relations avec l’extérieur Prêter son concours, en tant que de besoin, aux préparatifs des réunions des comités permanents, des groupes de travail et, si nécessaire, d’autres groupes de l’AIE ; participer aux réunions pertinentes d’autres organisations internationales ; concourir à l’établissement des rapports, analyses et éléments d’information destinés à ces réunions. "},"qualifications":{"title":"Qualifications","text":" Profil idéal Formation Diplôme universitaire de niveau supérieur ou doctorat en génie électrique, génie énergétique, génie des systèmes énergétiques, économie de l’énergie, physique ou dans une discipline connexe. Expérience professionnelle Au moins trois ans d’expérience directement acquise sur les systèmes électriques dans une entreprise du secteur de l’électricité, une société de conseil économique ou une entreprise axée sur les technologies de réseau, travaillant sur les réseaux de transport ou de distribution, l’exploitation des systèmes, la gestion de l’énergie ou un domaine connexe. Solide connaissance technique des systèmes électriques et expérience du travail avec des compagnies d’électricité et/ou des gestionnaires de réseau de transport. Compréhension approfondie des concepts liés à la sécurité de l’approvisionnement en électricité, des fondamentaux du marché de l’électricité et de l’interaction entre l’exploitation du système et les incitations du marché. Solide connaissance des réseaux de distribution de moyenne et de basse tension, avec une bonne compréhension des cadres régissant les processus de raccordement et l’intégration des ressources énergétiques décentralisées. Une expérience de la planification du réseau et des pratiques opérationnelles visant à améliorer l’efficience et l’utilisation des infrastructures existantes est souhaitable. Une expérience de la modélisation des systèmes électriques, notamment la modélisation des réseaux en régime stationnaire, en régime dynamique ou en stabilité transitoire, ou de l’étude de la planification ou de l’extension du réseau constituerait un avantage. Capacités d’analyse avérées et excellente compétence rédactionnelle, confirmées par les produits de travaux antérieurs (rapports analytiques, analyses quantitatives, modèles opératoires et/ou textes publiés). Outils Excellente maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office, en particulier d’Excel. Solide connaissance de langages de programmation pertinents (Python ou R, par exemple). Une expérience des outils de visualisation des données (Power BI, Tableau, par exemple) et de la gestion de base de données (SQL) est souhaitable. Une expérience des modèles et des plateformes d’optimisation telles que Pyomo, PyPSA ou GAMS constituerait un atout. Langues Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral, avec des compétences rédactionnelles et éditoriales. La connaissance d’une ou de plusieurs autres langues constituerait un atout. "},"additionalInformation":{"title":"Informations supplémentaires","text":" Compétences clés Les membres du personnel de l’OCDE sont censés faire preuve d’un comportement conforme aux six compétences clés qui seront évaluées dans le cadre de la procédure de recrutement organisée au titre de la présente offre d’emploi : Vision et stratégie (niveau 2) ; Renforcement des capacités des personnes (niveau 1) ; Éthique et intégrité (niveau 2) ; Collaboration et horizontalité (niveau 2) ; Obtention de résultats (niveau 2) ; Innovation et acceptation du changement (niveau 2). Pour en savoir plus sur les définitions des niveaux de maîtrise 1 à 3 associés à chaque compétence, veuillez vous référer au Cadre de compétences clés de l’OCDE . Durée du contrat Durée déterminée de deux ans, avec possibilité de renouvellement. Veuillez noter que, conformément aux Statut et Règlement applicables aux agents de l’Organisation, l’âge de départ obligatoire à la retraite est fixé à 67 ans. Processus de sélection Pour les personnes retenues à l’issue de la présélection, la procédure de recrutement peut comporter l’enregistrement d’un entretien vidéo, une évaluation des compétences professionnelles et un entretien avec un jury. Le présent processus de sélection permettra d’établir une liste de personnes qualifiées que les responsables de l’AIE pourront prendre en considération dans le cadre de futurs recrutements à l’Agence. Les personnes inscrites sur cette liste à l’issue de ce processus de sélection pourront être invitées à des entretiens ultérieurs destinés à permettre l’évaluation de l’adéquation des profils avec des besoins spécifiques. Ces entretiens seront fonction de la spécialisation/du domaine d’intérêt des personnes concernées. Date de clôture Les fonctions décrites ci-dessus seront pourvues dès que possible, et les candidatures devront nous parvenir au plus tard le 14 septembre 2026 à 23h59 (heure de Paris). Ce qu’offre l’OCDE Le salaire mensuel minimum s’élève à 6 008 EUR, plus allocations/indemnités en fonction de la situation personnelle, la rémunération globale étant exonérée d’impôt sur le revenu en France. Cliquez ici pour consulter les Statut, Règlement et Instructions applicables aux agents de l’Organisation. Veuillez noter que tout

item.title: Lead Digital Specialist
item.description: Working at the World Bank Group (WBG) provides a unique opportunity for you to help our clients solve their greatest development challenges. The WBG is one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries; a unique global partnership of five institutions dedicated to ending extreme poverty, increasing shared prosperity and promoting sustainable development. With 189 member countries and more than 120 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org The East Asia Pacific Region East Asia Pacific (EAP) is a large and diverse region, ranging from Small Island States of the Pacific to the Philippines, Indonesia and China. Despite substantial economic growth and poverty reduction, the EAP region faces huge development challenges. Growth has been uneven across and within countries, institutions still need strengthening, and most countries are heavily affected by climate change. The WBG plays a significant role on global public goods, including climate, biodiversity, water pollution, and health. The World Bank Group is seen as a premier development institution in EAP, with a leadership role on analytical and advisory services as well as financing. East Asia and the Pacific Region: https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/eap Digital AI Vice Presidency Digital technologies offer a unique opportunity to transform development through digital solutions. The Digital and AI Vertical Vice Presidency, and its global and regional teams, support client countries in building their capacities for Digital and AI use. The WBG Digital and AI Vertical is led by a Vice President and was established in July 2024. Our work is anchored in the Digital and AI Strategy, which includes four pillars: access, affordability, ecosystem and AI readiness. The Digital and AI Strategy identifies the priorities that WBG will engage in over the next five years. The Vertical deploys a range of products, services, and partnerships to advance global knowledge across the four pillars of the Strategy through: • Supporting WBG regions that provide financing to governments in the form of grants, loans, guarantees, and risk management products to support digital investment projects and implement policy reforms. • Supporting WBG regions that provide advisory services including targeted policy guidance, technical assistance, and capacity building. • Knowledge products including data and diagnostics to provide actionable insights at regional, country, and local levels, research and thought leadership to expand the global knowledge base, as well as thematic operational toolkits. • Convening services that bring together key stakeholders, from both public and private sectors as well as international and non-governmental organizations involved in advancing global digital transformation. For more information: https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/digitaldevelopment The Opportunity The WBG engagement in Digital is rapidly growing in the EAP in response to increased client demand for knowledge, technical assistance and financing. The Lead Digital Specialist will lead selected strategic or complex Digital knowledge and operational activities in Indonesia and Timor Leste, coordinate with the ASEAN Secretariat and among ASEAN members on digital issues, and support the delivery of the digital work program across EAP, ensuring technical and operational excellence, and alignment with the Digital and AI Strategy Implementation Plan (FY26–30) and the WBG’s corporate priorities, including the more and better jobs (MBJ) agenda. The Lead Digital Specialist will also play a key role in ensuring that digital activities and initiatives are well-coordinated and integrated across country and regional portfolios in EAP. DUTIES ACCOUNTABILITIES The position is based in Jakarta, Indonesia, and reports to the Practice Manager (PM) for Digital AI for EAP (DEPDU). Key responsibilities include: • Strategic Leadership o In close coordination with the Digital EAP PM, provide technical direction for the Digital AI work program, ensuring alignment with the Digital and AI Strategy Implementation Plan (FY26–30) and EAP regional strategies. o Represent DEPDU in high-level policy dialogues, partnership meetings and regional events, including with the private sector, on Digital and AI. o Connect the mission of DEPDU in delivering on the WBG Digital and AI Strategy Implementation Plan with the efforts of other verticals and sectors, including across the WBG and with IFC and MIGA. o Contribute to the development of partnerships and relationships with external stakeholders, provide technical direction and coordination as part of the WBG’s development partner relationship with the ASEAN Secretariat for digital, and support the effective, timely and relevant reporting of results and impact to donors. • Technical Expertise and Digital Program Delivery o Provide technical leadership to DEPDU teams and client governments on complex digital development issues, including digital and data infrastructure, Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), data governance, cybersecurity, and AI for development. o Lead strategic lending operations. o Work closely with TTLs and country teams to provide guidance, where determined necessary by the Digital EAP PM, on key areas of project design, development, and implementation support and supervision. o Lead the design and implementation of flagship knowledge products for DEPDU, ensuring they are policy-relevant and actionable for client countries. • Operational Support and Mentoring o Guide task teams in integrating the solutions of the World Bank Group’s Global Digital AI Implementation Plan into WBG Lending and Advisory Services and Analytics (ASA) operations across the EAP region. o In close coordination with the Digital EAP PM, review and clear technical deliverables—policy notes, concept notes, mission outputs—to ensure high quality standards and compliance with all corporate requirements, and provide hands-on guidance to task team leaders and client-facing teams on project design and implementation. o Support the Digital EAP PM on portfolio and budget monitoring, anticipating issues and advising the PM on ad hoc issues regarding country engagements (portfolio, sector dialogue), as well as dialogue with country units and partners. o Liaise with global expert teams to provide regional contribution to the Knowledge Bank in alignment with the World Bank Group’s Global Digital AI Strategy; and mobilize support by the Knowledge Bank to regional engagements. o Provide leadership, effective guidance and mentoring, supporting the Digital EAP PM, and serving as a technical adviser to more junior colleagues where needed. • Partnership Management and Outreach o In close coordination with the Digital EAP PM, serve as the focal point in EAP for coordination and engagement with key regional partners, donors and stakeholders active on digital issues. o Facilitate collaboration across the WBG, including between DEPDU, other WBG Global Practices, IFC and MIGA, and EAP CMUs, to ensure the effective transfer of Digital AI knowledge and innovation across sectors. o Provide technical support to colleagues working in other sectors to leverage digital technologies to improve public service delivery and to stimulate digital innovation, entrepreneurship and private sector-led investment. • Results Monitoring, Financial Management and Governance o Ensure effective monitoring, evaluation, and reporting against the Digital and AI Strategy Implementation Plan (FY26–30) Results Framework and workplan indicators for Digital in EAP. o Promote learning, transparency, and knowledge sharing through publications, workshops, and digital platforms.

item.title: Statistician – Prices and Purchasing Power Parities
item.description: {"id":"744000142880632","name":"Statistician – Prices and Purchasing Power Parities","uuid":"ab6f282f-38b1-4213-af14-5736f6f1fb26","jobId":"6192243d-bcde-4eb4-86d3-4c4d99ea7853","jobAdId":"d03ba090-dd0e-4986-8346-9cd6d65cc8a2","defaultJobAd":true,"refNumber":"REF3332C","company":{"name":"OECD","identifier":"OECD"},"location":{"city":"Paris","region":"Île-de-France Region","country":"fr","remote":false,"hybrid":true,"fullLocation":"Paris, Île-de-France Region, France"},"customField":[{"fieldId":"648821a3b6b69322b51f3093","fieldLabel":"Directorate","valueId":"10001187","valueLabel":"SDD"},{"fieldId":"COUNTRY","fieldLabel":"Country/Region","valueId":"fr","valueLabel":"France"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4cccb","fieldLabel":"Department","valueId":"6106611","valueLabel":"Policy Analysis and Legal"},{"fieldId":"633d99302e608549cea4ccca","fieldLabel":"Brands","valueId":"default","valueLabel":"OECD"},{"fieldId":"64882104a519d256d6751438","fieldLabel":"Grade","valueId":"PAL3","valueLabel":"PAL3"}],"releasedDate":"2026-08-11T13:39:00.967Z","creator":{"name":"","avatarUrl":""},"postingUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000142880632-statistician-prices-and-purchasing-power-parities","applyUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/OECD/744000142880632-statistician-prices-and-purchasing-power-parities?oga=true","referralUrl":"https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/external-referrals/company/OECD/publication/ab6f282f-38b1-4213-af14-5736f6f1fb26?dcr_ci=OECD","jobAd":{"sections":{"companyDescription":{"title":"Company Description","text":" The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development ( OECD ) is an international organisation comprised of 38 member countries, that works to build better policies for better lives. Our mission is to promote policies that will improve the economic and social well-being of people around the world. Together with governments, policy makers and citizens, we work on establishing evidence-based international standards, and finding solutions to a range of social, economic and environmental challenges. From improving economic performance and creating jobs to fostering strong education and fighting international tax evasion, we provide a unique forum and knowledge hub for data and analysis, exchange of experiences, best-practice sharing, and advice on public policies and international standard-setting. The Statistics and Data Directorate (SDD) ( www.oecd.org/sdd ) provides statistics and data on a comparable basis and from a variety of sources to analysts, policy makers and members of civil society. SDD also develops new metrics and innovative digital tools to address emerging policy issues, leads the development of international statistical standards, advances statistical methodology and co-ordinates statistical and data-related activities within the Organisation and with other international organisations. The Directorate currently employs more than 90 staff members who support statistical work across a broad range of policy areas . Within SDD, the Trade and Productivity Statistics Division (TPS) oversees the development and dissemination of productivity, prices, purchasing power parities (PPPs), labour, business and international trade statistics and undertakes studies related to measurement in these fields. SDD/TPS is looking for a Statistician to contribute to its work programme on PPPs and other topics covered by the Division. The successful candidate will have advanced skills in applying statistical and econometric techniques, excellent programming skills, and previous experience in research and analytical activities. Proven ability to handle large datasets, as well as good drafting skills would be an advantage. S/he will be able to work independently but also collaborate with other team members. The successful candidate will report to the Head of the Prices and Productivity Statistics Section in TPS. "},"jobDescription":{"title":"Job Description","text":" Main Responsibilities Statistical work, economic research and drafting Contribute to the production (i.e. calculation, survey management and validation, data checks, etc.) of PPPs and related indicators, such as comparative price levels, for countries under the responsibility of the OECD in the joint Eurostat-OECD programme and all the associated documentation, briefing materials etc. Contribute to blog posts or short papers to disseminate and promote the OECD’s work on PPPs. Contribute to the analytical and research activities of the Division and to the production of working papers and publications related to measurement issues. Keep abreast of research on PPPs and relevant methodological developments. Assist with the maintenance of core databases, as needed. Support the continuous improvement and modernisation of PPP update processes and data infrastructure, including through the expansion and maintenance of related documentation. Communication, liaison and representation Develop good working relationships with colleagues across the OECD and other relevant OECD directorates to ensure co-ordination on work associated with the work programme on PPP statistics and other statistics covered by the Division. Establish contacts with data producers in national statistical offices, national administrations and other international organisations, and with academics in the wider research community working on related topics. Participate in expert meetings and workshops related to productivity measurement and analysis, and prepare and present research papers to a wide array of audiences. Provide overall support to the Head of the Section and undertake other tasks as required. "},"qualifications":{"title":"Qualifications","text":" Ideal Candidate Profile Academic Background An advanced university degree or equivalent qualification in statistics, economics or econometrics, with a strong foundation in quantitative analysis and statistics. Professional Background At least two years of professional experience working with economic statistics; experience working with price statistics and PPPs would be a distinct advantage. Experience in the production, maintenance and quality assurance of statistical indicators. Knowledge of data visualization tools would be an advantage. Previous experience in research and analytical activities; experience in quantitative analysis, including a solid understanding of macroeconomic concepts, would be an advantage. Excellent skills in handling large datasets would be an advantage. Good drafting skills would be an advantage. Experience in preparing research papers within academia or an international organisation would be an asset. Tools Extensive knowledge of Excel. Knowledge of VBA would be an advantage. Excellent programming skills and experience with data management and analysis using software such as R, Python or Stata. Experience in web-scraping software tools and/or machine-learning techniques would be a distinct advantage. "},"additionalInformation":{"title":"Additional Information","text":" Core Competencies OECD staff are expected to demonstrate behaviours aligned to six core competencies which will be assessed as part of this hiring processes: Vision and Strategy (Level 1); Enable People (Level 1); Ethics and Integrity (Level 1); Collaboration and Horizontality (Level 1); Achieve Results (Level 2); Innovate and Embrace Change (Level 2). To learn more about the definitions for each competency for levels 1-3, please refer to OECD Core Competencies . Languages Fluency in one of the two OECD official languages (English and French) and knowledge of the other, with a commitment to reach a good working level. Fluency in Spanish would be an advantage. Closing Date This vacancy should be filled as soon as possible, and applications should reach us no later than midnight 15 September 2026 (Paris time). Contract Duration Open-ended appointment, with no foreseen end date. Please note that our Rules and Regulations stipulate that the mandatory retirement age is 67. What the OECD offers Monthly salary starts at 5 279.34 EUR, plus allowances based on eligibility, exempt of French income tax. Click here to visit our Salary and Allowances Calculator. Click here to consult the Staff Regulations applicable to officials of the OECD. Please note that from 1 July 2025, all Official appointments will be made under the OECD’s new contractual modalities . Click here to learn more about what we offer and why the OECD is a great place to work. Click here to browse our People Management Guidebook and learn more about all aspects relating to people at the OECD, our workplace environment and many other policies supporting staff in their daily life. Please note that the appointment may be made at one grade lower in the specified job family, based on the qualifications and professional experience of the selected applicant. This vacancy may be used to create a pool of candidates for comparable positions, both for open-ended and fixed-term functions. Selection Process For retained candidates, the selection process may include a video-recorded interview, job-based assessment and panel interviews. The OECD is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes the applications of all qualified candidates [who are nationals of OECD member countries ]*, irrespective of their racial or ethnic origin, opinions or beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, health or disabilities. The OECD promotes an optimal use of resources in order to improve its efficiency and effectiveness. Staff members are encouraged to actively contribute to this goal.
